scientificQuestion: Computational triage of candidate small-molecule inhibitors for a validated oncology kinase target (human BRAF, V600E context).
note: This file specifies WHAT genuine external payloads must be acquired (endpoints, formats, required fields) so a network-enabled operator can build the real bundle. It asserts NOTHING about the CONTENT of any record — content comes only from the real acquired payloads. Exact source IDs marked 'resolve' MUST be resolved by the operator via the documented query, not assumed.

sources.sourceId: resolve: human BRAF primary accession (search UniProtKB gene=BRAF organism_id=9606, reviewed)
sources.licenceMetadataRequirement: record UniProt distribution licence (CC-BY 4.0) explicitly; do not guess

sources.sourceId: resolve: an experimental BRAF kinase-domain structure PDB ID (query RCSB by UniProt accession)
sources.licenceMetadataRequirement: RCSB PDB data are public domain (CC0); record explicitly
sources.campaignRole: structure availability (NOTE: existence is not docking validity)

sources.sourceId: resolve: BRAF ChEMBL target id, then bioactivities (standard_type in {IC50,Ki,Kd,EC50})
sources.licenceMetadataRequirement: ChEMBL is CC-BY-SA 3.0; record explicitly. PRESERVE standard_type/relation/value/units (Ki != IC50).

sources.sourceId: resolve: CIDs for the ChEMBL seed molecules (map via InChIKey)
sources.licenceMetadataRequirement: PubChem data are public domain; record explicitly. Respect PUG usage policy (<=5 req/s).
sources.campaignRole: canonical compound identity + SMILES for RDKit/ADMET

sources.licenceMetadataRequirement: record per-record licence; open-access flag != reusable full text. Store UNKNOWN when unknown.

failClosedIf: any mandatory source is missing, any content hash mismatches, or any provenance is absent
